mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate activity (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth slows below 1% YoY and consumer spending (RSAFS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < 1% and RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY < 1% and RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals resilient supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 2% in 1 month during monetary tightening
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 2% in 1 month during monetary tightening.
